preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right') and hasattr(root, 'data'))
preconditions.description: The root is either None or a valid node object with left, right, and data attributes.
If root exists, its data value is between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.left is None or (hasattr(root.left, 'left') and hasattr(root.left, 'right') and hasattr(root.left, 'data')))
preconditions.description: If root has a left child, it is a valid node object.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.right is None or (hasattr(root.right, 'left') and hasattr(root.right, 'right') and hasattr(root.right, 'data')))
preconditions.description: If root has a right child, it is a valid node object.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if the tree rooted at 'root' is a complete binary tree, where every level except possibly the last is completely filled and all nodes in the last level are as far left as possible.
